definitions.explanation: Stretchy, sweat-wicking clothing designed for yoga practice. The term covers both studio-only outfits and athleisure pieces worn casually.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧ヨガウェア⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
ヨガウェア⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動く：00904_ugoku⟧やすい⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Yoga wear often uses easy-to-move-in fabrics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{普段着|ふだんぎ}→普段着：15346_fudangi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ヨガウェア⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Lately many people wear yoga clothes as everyday wear too.

notes:
Wasei-eigo style loanword (the English would normally be "yoga clothes" or "activewear"). Includes tops, leggings, and bras designed for stretching and sweating.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ヨガウェア⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear yoga clothes
- ヨガウェアブランド: yoga wear brand
- {速乾|そっかん}ヨガウェア: quick-drying yoga wear

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧ウェア: sportswear — broader; covers all athletic clothing
- アスレジャー: athleisure — athletic clothes designed to look stylish for everyday wear
